chapterInfo.content:
118
Asafo no aseda dwom
1 # Dwom 107.1 Monna AWURADE ase, na ɔyɛ,
na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
2 # Dwom 115.9-13 Ma Israel nka ɛ:
Aane, n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
3Ma Aaron fiefoɔ nka ɛ:
Aane, n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
4Ma wɔn a wɔsuro AWURADE nka ɛ:
Aane, n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
5Mefiri ahohia mu mefrɛɛ AWURADE,
na AWURADE gyee me so, deɛ ɛhɔ trɛ.
6 # Dwom 56.4; Heb 13.6 AWURADE wɔ m’afa, mensuro,
ɛdeɛn na onipa bɛtumi ayɛ me?
7 # Dwom 54.7 AWURADE wɔ m’afa sɛ me boafoɔ,
na me nso mɛhunu deɛ mepɛ m’atamfoɔ soɔ.
8Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔtwere AWURADE
sene sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto nnipa soɔ.
9 # Dwom 146.3 Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔtwere AWURADE
sene sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto ahemfo soɔ.
10Amanaman nyinaa atwa me ho ahyia,
AWURADE din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn maguo.
11Wɔatwa me ho ahyia awie koraa mpo,
nanso AWURADE din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn maguo.
12 # Yes 33.12 Wɔatwa me ho ahyia sɛ nwowa,
wɔbɛdum sɛ nkasɛɛ mu gya,
AWURADE din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn maguo.
13Wɔwɔɔ me nkonsia sɛ anka menhwe ase,
nanso AWURADE aboa me.
14 # Eks 15.2 M’ahoɔden ne m’ayeyie dwom ne AWURADE,
na wayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.
15Osebɔ ne nim gyegye ateneneefoɔ ntomadan mu,
AWURADE nifa di mmaninsɛm.
16Wɔama AWURADE nifa so,
AWURADE nifa di mmaninsɛm.
17Merenwu, na mmom mɛnya nkwa,
na maka AWURADE nneyɛɛ makyerɛ.
18 # 2 Ko 6.9 Aso na AWURADE atwe me,
na owuo deɛ, wamfa me amma no.
19Monhini tenenee aponkɛseɛ mma me,
na menhyɛne mu
menna AWURADE ase.
20AWURADE ponkɛseɛ nie,
ateneneefoɔ bɛhyɛne mu.
21 # Dwom 119.71 Meda wo ase sɛ woagye me soɔ,
na woayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.
22 # Yes 28.16; Mat 21.42 Ɔboɔ a abantofoɔ apa no
abɛyɛ tweaso boɔ titire.
23AWURADE na ɔmaa yei yɛeɛ,
ɛyɛ nwanwa yɛn ani so.
24Yei ne da a AWURADE ayɛ,
momma yɛnni ahurisie,
na yɛn ani nnye wɔ mu.
25O AWURADE, gye nkwa ɛ,
O AWURADE, ma no nsi yie!
26 # Mat 21.9; 23.39 Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam AWURADE din mu reba no,
yɛfiri AWURADE fie rehyira mo.
27AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn,
wama hann ahyerɛn ama yɛn.
Momfa dua mman ntwa afahyɛ asefoɔ no ho nhyia
nkɔduru afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho.
28Me Nyankopɔn ne wo, na mɛda wo ase,
me Nyankopɔn ne wo, mɛma wo so.
29Monna AWURADE ase, na ɔyɛ,
na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

Monna AWURADE ase, na ɔyɛ,
na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
Ma Israel nka ɛ:
Aane, n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
Ma Aaron fiefoɔ nka ɛ:

Ma wɔn a wɔsuro AWURADE nka ɛ:
Aane, n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.
Mefiri ahohia mu mefrɛɛ AWURADE,
na AWURADE gyee me so, deɛ ɛhɔ trɛ.
AWURADE wɔ m’afa, mensuro,
ɛdeɛn na onipa bɛtumi ayɛ me?
AWURADE wɔ m’afa sɛ me boafoɔ,
na me nso mɛhunu deɛ mepɛ m’atamfoɔ soɔ.
Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔtwere AWURADE
sene sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto nnipa soɔ.
Ɛyɛ sɛ wɔtwere AWURADE
sene sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛto ahemfo soɔ.
Amanaman nyinaa atwa me ho ahyia,
AWURADE din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn maguo.
Wɔatwa me ho ahyia awie koraa mpo,
nanso AWURADE din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn maguo.
Wɔatwa me ho ahyia sɛ nwowa,
wɔbɛdum sɛ nkasɛɛ mu gya,
AWURADE din mu ara na mɛtwitwa wɔn maguo.
Wɔwɔɔ me nkonsia sɛ anka menhwe ase,
nanso AWURADE aboa me.
M’ahoɔden ne m’ayeyie dwom ne AWURADE,
na wayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.
Osebɔ ne nim gyegye ateneneefoɔ ntomadan mu,
AWURADE nifa di mmaninsɛm.
Wɔama AWURADE nifa so,
AWURADE nifa di mmaninsɛm.
Merenwu, na mmom mɛnya nkwa,
na maka AWURADE nneyɛɛ makyerɛ.
Aso na AWURADE atwe me,
na owuo deɛ, wamfa me amma no.
Monhini tenenee aponkɛseɛ mma me,
na menhyɛne mu
menna AWURADE ase.
AWURADE ponkɛseɛ nie,
ateneneefoɔ bɛhyɛne mu.
Meda wo ase sɛ woagye me soɔ,
na woayɛ me nkwagyeɛ.
Ɔboɔ a abantofoɔ apa no
abɛyɛ tweaso boɔ titire.
AWURADE na ɔmaa yei yɛeɛ,
ɛyɛ nwanwa yɛn ani so.
Yei ne da a AWURADE ayɛ,
momma yɛnni ahurisie,
na yɛn ani nnye wɔ mu.
O AWURADE, gye nkwa ɛ,
O AWURADE, ma no nsi yie!
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔnam AWURADE din mu reba no,
yɛfiri AWURADE fie rehyira mo.
AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn,
wama hann ahyerɛn ama yɛn.
Momfa dua mman ntwa afahyɛ asefoɔ no ho nhyia
nkɔduru afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho.
Me Nyankopɔn ne wo, na mɛda wo ase,
me Nyankopɔn ne wo, mɛma wo so.
Monna AWURADE ase, na ɔyɛ,
na n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
